text: Bank of Japan raises its benchmark rate by 25 basis points to 0.75%, the highest since 1995, pushing 10-year Japanese government bond yields above 2% amid ongoing policy normalization.

meta.note: Rate increase occurs alongside weak growth data, creating policy tension not resolved at the snapshot point.

text: Christopher Waller completes a reported strong interview with Donald Trump for Fed chair, with discussion centered on job creation, as multiple candidates remain under consideration.

meta.note: Interview assessments are secondhand and nonbinding; no appointment decision is indicated at the snapshot point.

text: John Williams states that November CPI was likely biased downward due to data collection disruptions and technical adjustments following the October shutdown-related gap.

meta.note: Magnitude and category-specific effects of the distortion are not precisely quantifiable at the snapshot point.
